title: Leg picker with Straddles, Strangles, Strikes and Futures tabs and price columns (G-05-4)
reference_behaviour: A leg picker drawer has tabs for straddles, strangles, strikes and futures, an expiry list, a quick distance pick (50 to 200 points), price, OI and Greeks columns, and buy and sell buttons per strike.
ours: REQ-080 AC-1 to AC-3 not built: today's picker has plain selects and no columns. Straddle and strangle quick picks are REQ-079 AC-7 (held, Q211).
note: Not built here: the Straddles and Strangles tabs are REQ-079 AC-7, held on owner question Q211. The Strikes and Futures tabs are built (RD-129, RD-134).
